title: Part (v): integrality W_n | U_n cited, not proved (cancellation/2-adic content missing)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Section 7, Theorem `thm:v` and Remark `rem:vhard` ("is a theorem of Z.-W. Sun ... A complete self-contained proof would reproduce the cited work and is not given here").

**Gap.** Part (v), the integrality $W_n=2n\binom{2n}{n}\mid U_n=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(3k+1)\binom{2k}{k}^3 16^{n-1-k}$, is NOT proved. The two reductions in `lem:vrec` — $U_n=16U_{n-1}+(3n-2)\binom{2n-2}{n-1}^3$ and $W_n=4(2n-1)\binom{2n-2}{n-1}$ — are proved correctly (I verified both). Remark `rem:vhard` correctly shows term-by-term valuation bounds fail (cancellation; e.g. $n=2,\ell=3$ gives every term $v_3=0$ but $U_2=48$ has $v_3=1$). However the actual divisibility is only verified for $n\le200$.

**What must be proved.** (a) The cancellation congruence $\ell^{v_\ell(2n-1)}\mid U_n$ for every odd prime $\ell\mid 2n-1$, e.g. via the recurrence $U_n=16U_{n-1}+(3n-2)\binom{2n-2}{n-1}^3$ together with a Lucas/Kummer analysis; (b) the contribution $v_\ell\binom{2n-2}{n-1}\le v_\ell(U_n)$ for all $\ell$; and (c) a separate $2$-adic argument showing $v_2(U_n)\ge 2+v_2\binom{2n-2}{n-1}$ (the factor $4$ in $W_n$ is not the whole $2$-adic content). Numerics confirm $W_n\mid U_n$ is TRUE for $2\le n\le200$.
